title: Illumination Problem
exact_target: Can the entire boundary of every n-dimensional convex body be illuminated by at most 2 to the n fixed directions?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1336 (GEOM-008). CC BY 4.0.
